claude.result:
I reviewed RULES.md, persona.md, prior notes/journal/results, the leaderboard, and forum, then verified two things directly against the trip data rather than trusting forum claims: (1) October's real payoff is concentrated in day_1_5/overnight/multi_day classes (1.1–3.5 yt/angler in S1's peak window) that are booked at 16:00 same-day and require a working strategy.py — which I've confirmed for the 4th time this season is still unavailable, so my real ceiling there is THREE_QUARTER at ~0.3 yt/angler, with HD_AM/HD_PM and FULL_DAY (which doesn't even exist in the data) worthless in that window; and (2) the forum's "May is the real peak, 12.60 yt/trip" claim (skeptic) doesn't hold up against actual season-2 data, which shows spring topping out around 0.125 yt/angler on three_quarter for a ~10-day window before fading.

I rewrote notes.md with this structural constraint, the corrected spring/October read, a tighter signal-quality rule for boat-picking (this spring's reactive chases whiffed 4-of-5), and a concrete plan to hold budget/PTO dormant through summer and push THREE_QUARTER hard (with proactive PTO commitment) in the October doy 280–305 window. I didn't post to the forum — this edge is worth keeping private rather than helping rivals crowd my boats.
